narrative.summaryIntro:
Akshardham Temple in Delhi is a modern Hindu temple complex dedicated to Swaminarayan and is one of the largest and most elaborately decorated Hindu temples in the world. Completed in 2005 by the Bochasanwasi Akshar Purushottam Swaminarayan Sanstha (BAPS), the temple showcases a remarkable synthesis of ancient Hindu architectural traditions with contemporary construction techniques and craftsmanship.

The temple complex spans fourteen acres and features a magnificent central structure adorned with intricately carved marble, sandstone, and granite. The main sanctum houses the deities of Swaminarayan and his spiritual successors. Beyond its architectural magnificence, Akshardham serves as a cultural and spiritual center, offering exhibitions, cultural programs, and educational activities that promote Hindu values and traditions. The temple is one of Delhi's most visited tourist attractions and a major pilgrimage destination for the Swaminarayan faith.
